## Unparented

### Name peers from their BEP 20 peer id when no extension handshake names them

`proposed` · `@templartorrent.work.peer-id-client-fallback/1`

Close the README's "peer-ID client fallback" gap: a peer that sends no extension handshake, or one without a v string, showed as Unknown in the Peers tab. Decode Azureus-style, Shadow-style, Mainline and the known fixed-prefix ids into a bounded clean label at connection time, keep the extension handshake's own name as the better source when it arrives, and never let the guess reach policy.
